description.value: Tre Fantastico is a bistro-style restaurant and bar opened in 2011 inside the Parkside Hotel, steps from Beacon Hill Park in the heart of downtown Victoria, and one of three Caffe Fantastico locations. It centres on three pillars — espresso, local craft ales, and an extensive BC-only wine list hand-selected by the owner — alongside a seasonally driven menu of locally sourced bistro food. The West Coast-designed space features floor-to-ceiling windows, a walnut and concrete bar, live-edge wood slab tables, and a patio, making it a comfortable stop for locals and travelling visitors alike.
